[[File:ToxicGunnerImmune.png|20px|Poison Damage]]20 (Poison) |ranged_firerate = N/A |ranged_range = N/A |speed = 4 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision & Splash only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Poison Ducky''' is one of the five duckies spawned by the [[Ducky Squad]] consumable. It has a low amount of health and creates an explosion upon death. Upon death, the '''Poison Ducky''' will create an explosion which deals 100 damage to all enemies hit in its explosion radius of 6. This explosion can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, bypasses defense and has no damage drop off. Any enemy hit by the explosion will have poison applied to them, which deals 20 damage every 0.5 tick and slows down enemies by 15% for 3 seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Poison Ducky''' is a regular yellow duck with black eyes, orange beak and orange flippers. It wears a green cap and grey shades. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared. ==Strategy== *The '''Poison Ducky''' can be used to stall enemies quite well, as most enemies are not immune to poison slowdowns. **The only enemies immune to it are [[Boss]] enemies. *The '''Poison Ducky''' can be used to deal with weaker hordes of enemies, as it deals decent splash damage. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Poison Ducky''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Poison Ducky''' added. {{TowerNavBox}}
